CustomField.formula:
IF (ISBLANK(Productivity_From__c), "",
IF(HOUR(Productivity_From__c) <= 12, TEXT(HOUR(Productivity_From__c)), TEXT(HOUR(Productivity_From__c)-12)) & ":" &
IF (MINUTE(Productivity_From__c) < 10, "0" + TEXT(MINUTE(Productivity_From__c)), TEXT(MINUTE(Productivity_From__c))) &
IF (HOUR(Productivity_From__c) < 12, " AM", " PM"))
CustomField.label: Productivity from Formula
